analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free is caused by xmlLoadEntityContent reporting an error with a stale parser input pointer after growing the external entity buffer. Inside xmlLoadEntityContent, xmlParserInputBufferGrow may realloc the underlying xmlBuf (freeing old memory and updating input->base/cur). On failure (res < 0), the code calls xmlFatalErr(ctxt, input->buf->error, NULL), which triggers error reporting that dereferences ctxt->input->cur/base in xmlParserPrintFileContextInternal. At this point ctxt->input still points to an input structure whose context pointers are inconsistent/stale relative to the reallocated buffer, so error-context printing reads freed memory.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered while parsing XML with a DTD/entity declaration that causes xmlStringDecodeEntitiesInt -> xmlLoadEntityContent to load an external parsed entity (via xmlLoadExternalEntity/fuzz entity loader), then repeatedly grow its input buffer. If xmlParserInputBufferGrow returns an error after a realloc/move of the buffer, xmlLoadEntityContent raises a fatal parser error before safely neutralizing/removing that input from error-context usage. The fatal error path prints parser file context and dereferences freed old buffer bytes, producing heap-UAF.
